families.name: Graphene / carbon layers
families.description: Single- and few-layer carbon systems; ARPES focuses on Dirac cones, doping, twist angle, minibands, and many-body velocity renormalization.

families.name: 2D insulators / h-BN
families.description: Wide-gap layered insulators used as substrates, tunnel barriers, and reference van der Waals crystals.

families.name: TMD semiconductors
families.description: Mo- and W-based dichalcogenides; ARPES tracks direct/indirect gaps, spin-orbit splitting, valleys, and layer-dependent band shifts.

families.name: Metallic / CDW TMDs
families.description: Layered metallic TMDs with superconductivity, charge-density waves, valley physics, and strong electron-phonon coupling.

families.name: Black phosphorus / phosphorene
families.description: Anisotropic puckered 2D semiconductor; ARPES emphasizes direction-dependent dispersion and thickness-tuned gaps.

families.name: 2D magnets
families.description: Van der Waals magnetic crystals; ARPES and spin-sensitive probes connect exchange splitting, magnetism, and dimensionality.

families.name: MXenes
families.description: 2D transition-metal carbides/nitrides with surface terminations; useful for metallic bands, functionalization, and device interfaces.

families.name: Xenes
families.description: Single-element 2D sheets such as silicene and stanene; ARPES focuses on substrate hybridization, spin-orbit coupling, and possible topological bands.

families.name: 2D COF/MOF frameworks
families.description: Designable porous 2D organic and metal-organic frameworks; useful for tunable gaps, catalytic sites, separation, and energy storage.
